DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous cell carcinoma

The presence of non-healing, painless, crusty lesions on both the penis and the finger in a heavy smoker is highly suspicious for squamous cell carcinoma. The previous unsuccessful treatments for syphilis and eczema further support this, as these conditions typically respond to standard therapies. I recommend a biopsy of both lesions to confirm the diagnosis.
